plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Profline FM demodulators (enterprise PEN 21222, PROFLINE-SFD-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports RF input signal strength, left / right audio levels and the RF input low / high level alarm states.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: profline_rf_level_dbuv
metrics.description: Profline SFD RF input signal strength in dBuV, read from PROFLINE-SFD-MIB sfdMsrRfInSignalStrength (1.3.6.1.4.1.21222.1.4.1.3.3.2.0). Values outside 0 to 150 are dropped. Values above 115 indicate overload.

metrics.name: profline_audio_left_level_dbfs
metrics.description: Profline SFD left audio level in dBFS, read from PROFLINE-SFD-MIB sfdMsrAudioLeftLevel (1.3.6.1.4.1.21222.1.4.1.3.5.1.0). Values outside -120 to 0 are dropped.

metrics.name: profline_audio_right_level_dbfs
metrics.description: Profline SFD right audio level in dBFS, read from PROFLINE-SFD-MIB sfdMsrAudioRightLevel (1.3.6.1.4.1.21222.1.4.1.3.5.2.0). Values outside -120 to 0 are dropped.

metrics.name: profline_rf_low_alarm_state
metrics.description: Profline SFD RF input low-level alarm from PROFLINE-SFD-MIB sfdMsrAlarmRfInLevelLow (AlarmStatus noProblem(1), warning(3), alarm(5)). noProblem maps to 1 (normal); warning and alarm map to 2 (abnormal). Values not defined in the MIB are dropped.

metrics.name: profline_rf_high_alarm_state
metrics.description: Profline SFD RF input high-level alarm from PROFLINE-SFD-MIB sfdMsrAlarmRfInLevelHigh (AlarmStatus noProblem(1), warning(3), alarm(5)). noProblem maps to 1 (normal); warning and alarm map to 2 (abnormal). Values not defined in the MIB are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
